SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File 709 (C)
S.I. Special Branch Station, 40
REPORT
Date July 22, 1940

Subject Miss Lilo LINKE - Fifth Column Activities.

Made by D.S.I. Pitts. Forwarded by D.I. Crawford.

Information has been received from a reliable
source in Panama that a Miss Lilo LINKE is under
South America
suspicion in Bogota, Colombia, of being a Fifth
Columnist. She carries a letter of recommendation
and introduction on the letterhead of the Co-ordinating
Committee for Refugees, Bloomsbury House, Bloomsbury
Street, London, W.C.1. She may carry other
letters of recommendation. She presents herself as
a pure Aryan who fled from Germany to England because
she was not in accord with Hitler's policies. She
states she is an authoress. Although the subjects of
her books are not known it is believed that one of
her volumes was critical of the Nazis.

This information is passed on for what it is
worth so that the British and American authorities
in Shanghai and/or elsewhere can take what action
they deem fit.

C 22/7
Ja Pitts.
D.S.I.
D.C. (Special Branch).

22/7

报告
日期：1940年7月22日

主题：莉洛·林克（Lilo LINKE）小姐——第五纵队活动。

呈报人：副督察皮茨（Pitts）。转呈人：督察克劳福德（Crawford）。

据巴拿马方面可靠消息来源称，莉洛·林克（Lilo LINKE）小姐在哥伦比亚波哥大涉嫌为第五纵队分子。她持有一封推荐信及介绍信，信头印有“难民协调委员会”（Co-ordinating Committee for Refugees），地址为伦敦 W.C.1 区布鲁姆斯伯里街（Bloomsbury Street）布鲁姆斯伯里大楼（Bloomsbury House）。她可能还持有其他推荐信。她自称是纯雅利安人，因不认同希特勒的政策而从德国逃往英国。她声称自己是一位作家。虽然其著作的具体题材不详，但据信其中一卷曾对纳粹持批评态度。

现将此情报转达，以供参考，以便上海及/或他处的英美当局采取其认为适当的行动。

C 22/7
